name: datameet/railways (stations, trains, schedules)
license: ODbL-1.0 / data from Indian Railways via Datameet (see repo)
notes: Scheduled timetable snapshot (undated). No run-days: every train assumed daily. Only stations with coordinates kept that are state=Maharashtra or (state missing, ~half of stations, and inside a coarse hand-made Maharashtra outline polygon); stations lacking coordinates are skipped (their times are kept inside offsets). arrival==departure is treated as pass-through, so only stops with dwell>0 are halts (some real 1-min halts are lost). Foreign/other-state stations break segments; each contiguous MH segment is one route.

name: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API (POIs + metro/light_rail relations)

queryStatus.metro: Overpass returned 4 Mumbai-area relations (Lines 2B, 9 etc.); skipped: Mumbai metro already synthetic, Nagpur/Pune metro relations not obtained before time-box

notes: Places: named tourism/historic/worship objects ranked by tag richness (wikidata/wikipedia/heritage/website), capped at 12 per city; opening hours only when trivially parseable, otherwise category defaults; dwell times assumed. Metro: stop order from OSM relations; 3 min/stop and 06:00-22:00 every 10 min are ASSUMED (derived from OSM geometry; timings assumed). Cities with 0 places returned nothing/failed (see queryStatus).
